description: This Java class 'CrossFading' is an Android activity demonstrating the use of TransitionDrawable to perform a cross-fade animation between two Drawable objects (red and green Bitmaps). It sets up the UI, initializes the drawables, and toggles the cross-fade effect on ImageView click events.

classes.name: CrossFading
classes.description: An Android Activity class that demonstrates cross-fading between two Drawable images using TransitionDrawable.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creates two bitmaps (red and green), sets up the TransitionDrawable with these bitmaps, and assigns a click listener to toggle the cross-fade effect.
